gantt.title: Gantt chart
gantt.baselineShown: Thin grey bars show the current baseline.
gantt.exportFailed: The chart could not be exported.

portfolioGantt.title: Portfolio Gantt
portfolioGantt.description: Every project you can see with its phases and main milestones.

dashboard.title: Portfolio dashboard
dashboard.description: Health, value, budget and delivery of the projects you may see.
dashboard.insightsHint: Draft written by AI from the figures on this page. Check it before you share it.

heat.title: Health by department
heat.legend: R = red, A = amber, G = green: number of active projects in each health state. The cell colour shows the worst state.

bubble.title: Value and complexity
bubble.empty: No active project has both a value and a complexity score.
bubble.hint: Bubble size is the budget (when you may see costs); colour is the overall health.
bubble.aria: Bubble chart of {{count}} projects: value against complexity

budget.title: Budget and actual cost by department
budget.empty: No cost figures you may see.
budget.hidden_one: The costs of {{count}} project are hidden from you and not included.
budget.hidden_other: The costs of {{count}} projects are hidden from you and not included.

upcoming.title: Upcoming milestones (60 days)
upcoming.empty: No milestones due in the next 60 days.

groups.title: Portfolios & programmes
groups.description: Group projects into programmes and portfolios to steer them together.
groups.off: Portfolios and programmes are switched off in Settings → Portfolio.
groups.name: Name

grouping.title: Portfolio and programme
grouping.programmeHint: Choosing a programme also sets its portfolio.

settings.prioritisationOffHint: The default criteria with equal weights and the default bands are used. Switch prioritisation on to edit them.

features.title: Features
features.description: Switch the project management standards on or off. Data is kept when a feature is off and comes back when it is switched on.

portfolios.label: Portfolios & programmes
portfolios.description: Group projects into programmes and portfolios; filter dashboards and the Gantt by them.

prioritisation.label: Prioritisation
prioritisation.description: Weighted evaluation criteria and priority bands for requests.

health.label: RAG health
health.description: Schedule, cost, scope and risk health with overrides and the dashboard heat-map.

baselines.label: Baselines
baselines.description: Baseline at planning approval, re-baseline through change requests, variance.

earnedValue.label: Earned value
earnedValue.description: PV, EV, AC, SPI, CPI and forecasts (optional).

riskMatrix.label: Risk matrix
riskMatrix.description: 5 × 5 probability and impact matrix of project risks.

raci.label: RACI
raci.description: Responsible, accountable, consulted and informed per area.

communicationPlan.label: Communication plan
communicationPlan.description: Planned messages to stakeholders with due reminders.

benefits.label: Benefits
benefits.description: Expected benefits from the request, measured at impact.

quality.label: Quality sign-off
quality.description: Deliverables accepted by the owner before closure.

procurement.label: Procurement
procurement.description: Contract payment milestones and supplier rating.

statusReport.label: Monthly status report
statusReport.description: Bilingual PDF generated from the approved monthly update.

gateChecklists.label: Stage-gate checklists
gateChecklists.description: Checklist items at the charter, planning and closure gates.

templates.label: Project templates
templates.description: Start projects from templates of milestones, planning items, risks and epics.

agile.title: Agile delivery
agile.approvalModeHint: Approve progress at the end of each sprint, or once a month like waterfall projects.
agile.membersCreateStories: Team members may create user stories
agile.membersCreateStoriesHint: When off, only the project manager adds stories to the backlog.
agile.suggestionsHint: Proposed to the project manager when the methodology is chosen; the manager can pick another.

costs.title: Cost visibility
costs.membersSeeCosts: Team members may see project costs
costs.membersSeeCostsHint: Off by default: team members see the project without budget and cost figures.

health.title: Health thresholds
health.description: Limits between green, amber and red. Percentages are of the plan or budget.

checklists.title: Stage-gate checklists
checklists.description: Items the project ticks at each gate. Required items must be ticked before the gate can be submitted.

templates.title: Project templates
templates.description: Milestones, planning items, risks and epics a project manager can apply in charter or planning.
templates.name: Name
